cross_object_findings.finding: A test-count change repeatedly tripped freshness gates; evidence correctly converged on regenerating projection state instead of reverting a valid repair or reopening architecture.

The liveness challenge identifies that reversible engineering was carrying nearly the same burden as irreversible/scientific changes. Exact-head CI remains important, but fresh semantic review need not repeat for proven projection/test-only deltas.
PR46 exact-head hosted success proves the bounded bridge state machine, not global task selection, multi-task roadmap completion, whole-product integration or economic readiness.

Wave2 and Horizontal/Vertical work were preserved remotely but diverged from default and PR46. Later autonomy work occurred on a stale lineage, creating a real convergence/promotion gap rather than loss of all prior work.
Owner explicitly requires object-level semantic disposition and forbids treating indexed/collected evidence as read; this defines the current mission and its closure condition.
